Spiti : The Highland Circuit (Group Trip)

Delhi — Manali — Kaza — Langza — Komic — Hikkim — Key Monastery — Chicham Bridge — Kunzum Pass — Chandratal — Manali — Delhi

About This Trip

Experience the raw beauty of Spiti Valley with Awara Banjara's Spiti Highland Circuit expedition. Starting with an overnight AC Volvo journey from Delhi to Manali, traverse through high mountain passes, ancient monasteries, and iconic villages including Langza, Komic, and Hikkim. Visit the magnificent Key Monastery, cross Asia's highest bridge at Chicham, and camp near the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake before returning back via Manali. Designed for adventure lovers seeking an unforgettable Himalayan road trip experience.

Itinerary

Board a premium overnight Volvo coach departing from Delhi in the late evening. Relax in executive reclining seats on the overnight highway journey to Manali.

Arrive in Manali, check-in to stay, acclimatize, and explore local cafes and sights around Old Manali and Mall Road.

Drive from Manali across Atal Tunnel / Kunzum Pass into the rugged landscape of Spiti Valley to reach Kaza.

Visit the highest villages: Langza (Fossil Village), Komic (highest motorable village), and Hikkim (world's highest post office), along with iconic Key Monastery and Chicham Bridge.

Drive from Kaza over Kunzum Pass to reach the pristine, crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake for an overnight campsite stay under the stars.

Drive back from Chandratal to Manali and board the evening overnight Volvo coach towards Delhi.

Reach Delhi in the morning with lifelong memories of the Highland Circuit.
